scientific_integrity: Sharpness for all real arrays and all finite dimensions follows from a piecewise-affine secant representation and explicit input witnesses, not extrapolation from samples. The one-input identity is classical and is not asserted to be novel.
scientific_limitations: Uniform cells, real data, endpoint zero slopes, 0<=slope scaling<=1 and distributional first variation only. No result for numerical time evolution, weighted cells or nonlocal limiters; independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp two-input BV modulus of variation-preserving minmod reconstruction
